build_olmo_causal_lm: build an OlmoForCausalLM model from an OlmoConfig for autoregressive text generation
create_olmo_model: create an OlmoModel with OlmoDecoderLayers and OlmoLayerNorm for transformer inference
run_olmo_attention: run OlmoAttention with query, key, value projections and rotary position embeddings
test_olmo_rotary_embedding: test OlmoRotaryEmbedding forward pass that returns float32 cos and sin position embeddings
review_olmo_mlp: review OlmoMLP with separate gate and up projections instead of fused GELU multiplicative gating
